acceptance_criteria: Initial fleet-query failure renders unavailable and never renders a healthy zero-resource deployment.
A successfully observed empty fleet remains a distinct, testable zero-resource state.
Partial or retained stale fleet data cannot produce an unqualified healthy verdict.
Liveness loading, unavailable, explicitly not alive, and alive are distinct states.
A healthy line snapshot combined with unavailable or dead required process evidence is not healthy.
Version loading and version failure are distinguishable, and terminal failure offers retry.
Version failure leaves runtime health policy explicit while release/update status remains unknown.
Freshness and bounded last-success age appear in compact and accessible projections.
Recovery requires fresh success from every required input and emits one explicit transition.
Empty, unavailable, stale, degraded, critical, version-unknown, and recovered states have behavior coverage.
Mutation coverage fails if line query state is reduced to an empty-array fallback or liveness is removed from the aggregate verdict.
Tests and telemetry use reserved synthetic values and expose no locations, identities, credentials, raw errors, process details, or topology.
blast_radius: The console's deployment-wide readiness, fleet-size, agent-count, process-liveness, and release-status projections; observation outages can otherwise look like a healthy empty deployment.
evidence_summary: All decisive source and focused-test blobs are byte-identical between the prior pin and 9a1bd7b3d3c529b276c1ad764d2c312d7f3abfc3. Pinned main consumes only fleet-line data, coerces absence to an empty array that derives healthy, and computes the card verdict without liveness or release query availability; 5 issue-specific assertions within an 11-of-11 write-free source falsifier observed the claimed composition. Two focused deployment suites passed 18 of 18 tests again at the new exact main, and the prior shared six-suite run passed 200 of 200, but none covers query failure, retained-after-error data, recovery, or required/advisory evidence composition. A historical 529-issue, 1,984-PR, fully paginated 39-open-PR and 1,333-path-occurrence capture found no owner or open changed-path overlap; publication still requires the declared fresh estate rescan.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding is falsified if the pinned page preserves fleet, liveness, and release query availability/freshness, treats liveness as required evidence, distinguishes terminal version failure, and permits healthy zero only after complete success. The inspected flow does not. The issue's removed audit-only behavior tests could not be recreated because this lane forbids tracked writes, so runtime failure projections remain an explicit implementation-time test obligation; runner-level operating-system transient writes were not syscall-audited.
impact: An unavailable fleet read can appear as healthy with zero lines and agents, unavailable or dead process evidence cannot demote that verdict, and a failed release query remains indistinguishable from loading.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2531 immediately before publication and reject the record if its updated timestamp, title, labels, node ID, URL, or body hash changed.
Reconfirm exact SSH origin, local origin/main, remote main, and the decisive source bytes before ownership or implementation.
Re-scan the fully paginated issue, pull-request, and changed-file estate; no open pull request overlapped the affected paths at capture, and merged PR #2198 is partial history.
Adopt #2447 evidence vocabulary and #2523 safe presentation, preserve #2515's liveness authorization boundary, and coordinate rather than absorb #1876, #2467, #2481, and #2486.
Add direct fleet-error, liveness loading/error/dead, version-error, retained-data, recovery, accessibility, and evidence-composition behavior tests before completion.
Keep automatic restart and rollout mutation outside this visibility change and require separate mutation authority plus post-action recovery proof.
